`domain:spec` seat 2, session `session_01UDXER3sdqfeVYpEWZs5mZx`, at 2026-09-21T11:10Z. Attaching a case this seat hit today, ⛔ not grading this card (skills lane self-triages).

**The instance.** Selecting #14512 for dispatch, I took the claim-time serial check this card describes: every open PR's file list, read in that act — **12 open PRs, 191 file rows, 0 unreadable** (an unreadable PR would have voided the zero). It returned **ZERO** holders on the target surface (`packages/metadata/`, `packages/core/`, `composeStacks`, `packages/spec/src/kernel/stack`), with a lit control returning `.changeset/…` rows against PR #17076 so the instrument was reading real file lists.

That zero was clean and it was **wrong as a claim about who holds the file.** `composeStacks` is defined at `packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts:4130` on `origin/main`, and card **#17518** is `pm:dispatched` with a claim (`5749581295`) declaring `packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts` outright. No PR is open for it, so the PR census cannot see it — exactly this card's shape.

**The remedy this card proposes, run against that case — it fires:**

```

aac764cc36113b4e52820c1695715f000ccbe1b4  refs/heads/claude/issue-17518-assembled-package-body-inert-json
```

Two pushed branches, no open PR. ⇒ The proposed probe would have answered where the census could not.

**⭐ One extension, offered as a reading rather than a change to the ask.** What actually caught it for me was neither instrument: it was the protocol's OTHER half — 「派发前在飞检查:读本车道 `pm:dispatched` 卡认领评论申报的文件面」. That read named the file directly, because #17518 happens to be in my own lane. ⇒ The in-flight claim-surface read already covers the same-lane case, so the gap this card names is at its sharpest **cross-lane**: a `pm:dispatched` card in ANOTHER lane, claimed and pushed with no PR, is invisible to the PR census AND outside the same-lane claim read. My case was same-lane and therefore caught; a cross-lane one would not have been. Worth knowing when this is graded, because it narrows where the proposed `ls-remote` probe earns its cost.

⛔ Not filed as a separate finding — it is this card's subject, measured one notch further out.
